'''Marc McRae'''<ref name="dt-18092">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/18092 Run Luke  Run He disgusts me], DeckTech (Marc "Rahs" McRae, 6 August 2001). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/18092/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/18092/ GitHub Pages].</ref> (also published as '''Mark McRae'''; DeckTech handle '''Rahs''') finished 23rd at the [[2001 Ontario Provincial Championship]] on 12 May 2001, with the event's greatest Dark side differential win (+44), according to Drew Liu's tournament director's report.<ref name="tr-d2322">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-05-18-ontario-provs-tds-report-05-12-01d2322/ ontario-provs-tds-report-05-12-01], DeckTech (Drew "JediDrew" Liu, 18 May 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-05-18-ontario-provs-tds-report-05-12-01d2322/ GitHub Pages].</ref> He posted a [[Light]] [[Quiet Mining Colony / Independent Operation|Quiet Mining Colony]] list and a [[Dark]] [[Bring Him Before Me / Take Your Father's Place|Bring Him Before Me]] list on DeckTech in July and August 2001.
